title: Portal Mod Manifest (modinfo.json)
description: Schema for a Portal custom-experience manifest consumed by the Godot experience_exporter plugin (ModPackage). Describes the workspace, strings, skeleton, and level scenes that make up an exportable experience bundle.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON schema.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. Incremented manually when the manifest schema changes.

name.description: Display name of the custom experience.

author.description: Name of the person or studio that created the experience.

description.description: Description of the experience shown in the exporter and web builder.

base_skel.description: Skeleton (framework) file that levels, strings, and the workspace are appended to. Typically named '*_skel.json'.

workspace.description: Workspace (blocks) file for the experience. Its content has the {"mod": {"blocks": ...}} signature.

strings.description: Strings table file for UI text. Typically named '*.strings.json'.

script.description: Optional compiled script file attached to the experience.

icon.description: Icon file bundled with the exporter plugin, resolved relative to the plugin's icon directory.

game_mode.description: Game mode identifier. Combined with each map's map_name to form the map-rotation id.

maps.description: The levels included in the experience. Each entry maps a canonical level (map_name) to its level file (file_stem).

map_name.description: Canonical level id (matches a key in level_info.json and the level scene's .tscn root node). Combined with game_mode to form the map-rotation id.

file_stem.description: Level file name without extension. The exporter attaches '<file_stem>.spatial.json'.

additional_description.description: Optional suffix distinguishing variants of the same map (e.g. '(Winter)').
